items.title: Chipotle (CMG) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.summary: The Fair Value estimate for Chipotle Mexican Grill has shifted from US$42.71 to US$40.57, leaving it about 5% below the prior mark. Analysts link this reset in price targets to a more cautious stance that factors in recent food safety headlines, mixed near term growth drivers, and questions around how much of Chipotle’s long term earnings profile is already reflected in the stock. In the sections that follow, you will see how these moving parts shape the evolving narrative around Chipotle...
